author: deepseek-3.2
brief: Phase: code review. Role of the person asking: the developer who wrote the change. Repo kind: a Node.js invoicing service (invoice list and export endpoints, a small store, an HTTP client to a payment provider, config, tests, docs). The user wants a quick sanity check of their change before they put it up for review and says not to touch anything. Keep the change small: 4 to 6 files. Plant: an off-by-one in the page end index drops the last invoice of each page; a promise catch swallows the provider error and returns an empty list as success; a leftover debug log prints the request headers including the bearer token; a test fixture holds a live-looking provider secret key; a write to the store is not awaited so the response can go out before it fails; a config default timeout changes from 5000 to 50 by typo. Add one decoy.
